notes: Faster opening. Every start-up was waiting on a round trip to the server — the door check — before it would even show the data already saved on your device, and on a slow connection that wait could reach seven seconds of blank screen. The door check now runs alongside the disk load instead of in front of it: your saved shares appear straight away, and the server's answer is only waited for at the moment it's actually needed (before anything is fetched live). If a start is ever still slow, the status line now says exactly where the seconds went, so it can be fixed rather than guessed at.
